title: Feelings Traffic Light
goal: When a feeling gets big, children choose for themselves which of three lights they need: stop, breathe or say.
materials: 3 traffic-light cards (red, yellow, green, for the teacher)

steps.title: Hello
steps.heading: Feelings have a traffic light!
steps.cue: Gather the children so they can see the TV. Each time the character names a light, hold up the matching card: red, yellow, green.
lines: There's a traffic light for big feelings.
Red is Stop. Yellow is Breathe.
Green is Say! Let's try it today.

steps.title: The light I need
steps.cue: Ask the children to remember a time a feeling got big, then hold up the card for the light they need right now. Count each light and tap +. Once everyone is counted, tap Confirm.
steps.prompt: Which light do you need right now?
lines: Think of a time a feeling got big.
Which light do you need right now?
Pick one card and hold it up!

options.label: Stop
options.hint: pause and stay still for a moment

options.label: Breathe
options.hint: slow breath in through the nose, out through the mouth

options.label: Say
options.hint: say 'this is how I feel right now'

steps.on_confirm: You chose {signal_list}. [[signal_lead: Most of you chose {signal_lead}.]] [[stop: Pausing for a moment is a big strength.]] [[breathe: Your breath is always with you.]] [[say: Saying it out loud makes a feeling lighter.]] Whatever the light, you are the one who chooses. Thank you for choosing.

steps.title: Breathing timer
steps.heading: Yellow light: slow breaths
steps.cue: Start the timer and name the moves slowly, one at a time. Take a big, visible breath first and the children will follow. When 30 seconds are up, the character wraps it up.

moves.text: Breathe in slowly through your nose
Breathe out long through your mouth
Squeeze your fists, then open your hands wide

steps.done_line: Whoosh. Is your feeling a little quieter now? Let's sit back down.

steps.title: Our class story today
steps.heading: The lights our class chose
steps.cue: The character reads a story made from today's numbers. Afterwards, ask: 'Which light will you use when a feeling gets big?'
steps.template: Today {class} met the feelings traffic light. The lights our class chose: {signal_list}. [[signal_lead: {signal_lead} was chosen most of all.]] [[stop: Friends who chose Stop can pause for a moment when a feeling gets big.]] [[breathe: Friends who chose Breathe can take slow breaths through the nose.]] [[say: Friends who chose Say can tell someone, 'This is how I feel right now.']] Whatever the light, you choose it yourself. The traffic light is always with us.

steps.title: Our Class Book
steps.cue: The TV turns into a picture book of the lights our class chose today and reads it page by page. When it's done, tap Next.
steps.cover_line: Here is a book of the lights our class chose today.

steps.title: Goodbye
steps.heading: Thank you for today!
steps.cue: When the character finishes saying goodbye, tap Finish lesson. The family page link will be ready.
lines: Thank you for choosing your light today.
When a feeling gets big, remember the traffic light.

outro: That's all for today! Thank you, friends.

home.title: Keep it going at home
tips: When a feeling looks big, ask: 'Which light do you need right now? Red, yellow or green?' Whatever your child picks, do that light together.
The yellow light is easier when a grown-up goes first: breathe in slowly through the nose, then out long through the mouth.
When your child uses the green light and says 'This is how I feel,' answer with 'Thank you for telling me.' The traffic light is a tool your child chooses.
home.note: This page shows only class totals and the class story. No individual child's choice is recorded.
